rationale: The short thesis remains intact: price ($33.80) is holding below session VWAP ($34.80) and the 9-EMA ($33.86), sitting in the bottom 12% of today's range after a 33% gap-up faded, with broad risk-off (SPY -1.37%, VIXY +4.15%) supporting continued downside toward the $33.12 low and $32.70 target. Recent 1m candles show only flat consolidation at the lows (33.70–33.83) rather than a reclaim of VWAP, so neither the invalidation ($34.86) nor take-profit ($32.70) is close, and flipping long would fight both the intraday trend and the regime.
